svg.title: Service endpoint traffic flow
svg.desc: A VM in a subnet with a Microsoft.Storage service endpoint reaches the storage account's public endpoint over the Azure backbone using its private source IP. The service endpoint route bypasses the hub firewall. On-premises and internet clients are rejected by the storage firewall.
